title: EAL/3 cumulative reuse investigation: pilot-informed estimation and separate component diagnostics
question: Does EAL preserve correctness within five percentage points, exceed 90% absolute correctness and save over 20% cumulative tokens at ten fresh recipients, with an affordable allocation that controls false success and has useful joint decision power; which matched-fact diagnostics distinguish host reasoning and reuse contributions?

scope.system_or_population: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
scope.conditions: Primary: both donor models crossed with both recipient models and recipient native-tool access. EAL uses a task-specific checked host adapter and compact prompts. Separate diagnostics clone a common donor state and change one component per contrast.
scope.spatial_scope: Isolated synthetic project directories and OpenAI Responses API.
scope.temporal_scope: Initial session plus ten fresh recipients; report cumulative trajectories and the predeclared horizon. A separate pilot estimates information requirements before a fresh evaluation. Diagnostics use one donor and independently cloned recipient variants per block.
exclusions: The automated token comparison does not measure human authoring effort. Optional run-bound cost ledgers report measured adoption activities separately; unknown effort remains unknown.
No population model-class, isolated reasoning-capability or general EAL superiority claim.
The installed task contracts exercise declared finite evidence and reasoning dependencies; they do not validate every EAL reasoning mode or arbitrary engineering work.
Bundled snapshot reuse does not measure selective collection of individual evidence facts or general temporal logic.

claims.statement: Cumulative resource differences and correctness preservation can be estimated jointly for the declared finite task and model pool at a specified reuse horizon.
claims.scope_limit: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
claims.success_consequence: Report conjunctive decision and separate estimation intervals only under verified measurement and an independently selected evaluation allocation.
claims.failure_consequence: Retain observed losses and inconclusive intervals; cheap incorrect answers do not satisfy the joint practical criterion.

claims.statement: Matched-donor contrasts estimate effects of supplying a computed conclusion, evaluator choice, presentation, notes, response format and collection within declared task regimes.
claims.scope_limit: Ten default donor blocks; separate cadence diagnostics and external manifests have separately declared populations.
claims.success_consequence: Report component-specific observed differences and candidate explanations for further testing.
claims.failure_consequence: Report invalid manipulations, unresolved annotation or non-discrimination without attributing the primary workflow contrast to a component.

assumptions.statement: The task specification, authored EAL source, checked host decision adapter and independent reference distinguish the same evidence dependencies, decision rule, scope, missingness and validity conditions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Before-API actual-runtime calibration and source mutations: changed claim meaning, reversed threshold direction, changed threshold, missing measurement, incompatible scope and freshness/assumption boundaries. New task rules independently check three-valued composition and scoped, dated fact selection against separately authored expectations.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop live collection for invalid correspondence; an authored argument failure is an instrument/source failure, not a model failure.

assumptions.statement: Provider responses use the declared snapshot and interface, and recorded usage describes the actual transmitted request.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Snapshot checks and retained raw requests/responses; response mode and tool mask recorded per session. Schema enforcement is enabled only by the declared json_schema mode.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Retain failure and stop on access, budget or snapshot mismatch; do not substitute another model.

assumptions.statement: Each diagnostic contrast starts from identical donor artefacts and external fixture state, with only the declared input component changed.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Pre-session fingerprints, intervention manifests, unchanged-fixture checks, current task-fact equality and actual manipulation checks.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Keep the affected contrast and resources but mark it invalid for component attribution.

assumptions.statement: Automatic or human annotation represents the decision expressed in the retained answer, independently of whether that decision is correct.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Conservative annotation rules; known paraphrase, negation, contradiction and ambiguity cases; arm/case/oracle-masked manual coding and optional audit of all automatic labels.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Retain ambiguous decisions as pending and report bounds; preserve coding revisions and suspend claims sensitive to unresolved or discrepant labels.

assumptions.statement: Reduced prompt content preserves the task facts needed for the scoped host result; generic claim prose remains qualified by prose_verified rather than assumed formally proved.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Task-contract checks, statement-meaning mutations and claim text/qualification projection tests; full-versus-compact diagnostic has equal current task-fact fingerprints.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject the invalid contract or contrast before attributing quality or token differences to compression.

assumptions.statement: Pilot estimates and the declared sensitivity scenarios adequately represent repeated-sequence variation, missingness and resource use for the subsequent finite-pool evaluation.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Use fresh evaluation executions; report sparse cells, paired variability, correctness discordance and session dependence. Simulate complete matched sequence trajectories under the declared resource reservation rule; inspect sensitivity and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Label the proposed allocation inadequately informed or infeasible; retain conditional scenario results without an empirical power or population claim.

hypotheses.label: Compact context is sufficient
hypotheses.statement: Given identical current task facts, removing repeated presentation reduces input tokens while retaining the same distribution of task decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Explanatory context is needed
hypotheses.statement: Given identical current task facts, recipients need the fuller presentation to interpret them; compact presentation lowers task-decision accuracy.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Stale notes interfere
hypotheses.statement: Including a dated earlier positive conclusion alongside a current negative result increases erroneous positive decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Current result dominates
hypotheses.statement: Recipients reliably qualify the dated earlier conclusion and prioritise the current checked result; including the stale note does not increase erroneous positive decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Reporting requirements affect the task answer
hypotheses.statement: Requiring a JSON reporting contract changes the distribution of task decisions relative to prose under identical current task facts.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Reporting requirements affect only representation
hypotheses.statement: Requiring JSON changes formatting compliance and resources while leaving the distribution of task decisions unchanged under identical current task facts.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Computed conclusion helps
hypotheses.statement: Given identical raw facts and rules, supplying a checked conclusion improves recipient correctness.
hypotheses.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.

hypotheses.label: Facts suffice
hypotheses.statement: Given identical raw facts and rules, supplying a checked conclusion produces no practically relevant recipient correctness improvement.
hypotheses.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.

hypotheses.label: Joint practical null
hypotheses.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.

hypotheses.label: Joint practical benefit
hypotheses.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. predictions.expected_pattern: Compact projection uses fewer input tokens with no systematic loss of decision accuracy; a compact-specific loss is more consistent with H-002 than H-001.
predictions.direction: fewer tokens with preserved decision profile
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Direction of observed paired token and decision differences; this small sample has no equivalence margin or precision claim.
predictions.time_window: Recipient session after cloned donor state.
predictions.tolerance: Token counts exact where provider usage is complete; decision equality alone in this small sample cannot establish distributional equivalence.

predictions.expected_pattern: Including the specified stale positive note increases positive errors on the current negative case relative to omitting it.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Observed within-block decision differences; effect magnitude and repeatability require a later information design.
predictions.tolerance: One discordant pair identifies a possible sensitivity, not a reliable population effect; no discordance is non-discriminating at this sample size.

predictions.expected_pattern: Prose, prompted JSON and schema-enforced JSON produce different task-decision profiles after annotation is separated from formatting.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Observed paired decisions/resources; prompted JSON versus enforced JSON separately varies provider enforcement.
predictions.time_window: Independent cloned recipient sessions within a format block.
predictions.tolerance: Format differences without decision differences are shared by both packages in a small sample; no significance or equivalence conclusion.

predictions.expected_pattern: EAL conclusion versus facts alone increases correctness on matched rules/facts; conventional equal decisions provide an active output-equivalence control.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Estimate the donor-level contrast with simultaneous uncertainty; no equivalence from a small tied pilot.
predictions.time_window: Recipient session after cloned donor state.
predictions.tolerance: Token counts exact where provider usage is complete; decision equality alone in this small sample cannot establish distributional equivalence.

constructs.name: Reference-task decision agreement
constructs.definition: The answer expresses the same ready, not_ready or undetermined decision as an independent full-information task reference.
constructs.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
validity_evidence: Known positive, negative, missing and expired decisions; actual-runtime/source calibration; independent answer annotation with unknown labels preserved.
validity_threats: Decision agreement does not demonstrate that a model used a particular observation or argument.
Automatic prose annotation may miss paraphrases; ambiguous or contradictory expressions remain unclassified until blind review.
A justified abstention with inaccessible evidence can disagree with the full-information reference; its appropriateness is a separate outcome.
Selected synthetic task families underrepresent engineering work; separate AI authorship broadens construction but does not establish external validity or human authoring effort.

constructs.name: Component sensitivity under a controlled donor state
constructs.definition: Observed change in task decisions or resources after one declared component is varied between independently cloned recipient states.
constructs.scope: The declared diagnostic cases/configurations and cloned states.
validity_evidence: Donor and fixture fingerprints, current task-fact equality, treatment manifests and checks of actual recollection/format/projection/notes.
validity_threats: One execution per diagnostic variant has little information about stochastic distributions.
A manipulation may change unrecorded presentation details; failed equality checks invalidate component attribution.
A specified synthetic stale note tests sensitivity to that conflict, not prevalence of such notes in real projects.

constructs.name: Cumulative machine expenditure at preserved task correctness
constructs.definition: Initial plus ten subsequent sessions of measured input/output tokens, estimated API USD and elapsed seconds, interpreted jointly with the EAL-minus-ordinary mean correctness difference. The EAL mean recipient correctness must also be at least 0.90; relative preservation alone cannot qualify two uniformly poor workflows.
constructs.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
validity_evidence: Complete request receipts, initial/subsequent accounting, separate quality outcomes and declared horizon.
validity_threats: Human authoring time and host infrastructure prices are unmeasured.
A favourable resource ratio cannot compensate for correctness below the margin.
Pilot-calibrated simulation is conditional on selected tasks, model snapshots and the assumed missingness process.

constructs.name: Measured adoption expenditure
constructs.definition: Observed workflow activities valued at declared USD/hour rates, plus reconciled API costs.
constructs.scope: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
validity_evidence: Run/plan identity, unique events and explicit coverage with evidence references.
validity_threats: Unrecorded effort, inappropriate rates and incomplete infrastructure accounting.

measurements.observable: Unmodified task answer, independently annotated decision and optional basis/measurement/time citations; format and persistence outcomes recorded separately.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Response-format strategies, ReferenceScorer and annotation export/import; automatic prose coding only for complete standalone canonical decisions, with blinded coding for all other non-empty prose.
measurements.timing: Every initial and recipient session; every attempt retained.
measurements.preprocessing: Primary task_match/decision_match compares an annotated decision with independent fixture arithmetic. Basis agreement, voluntary citation agreement, coded internal consistency, abstention, false assertion and format compliance are secondary dimensions; absent secondary content is unmeasured, not a primary failure. Empty/no response is observed no-answer; ambiguous prose or malformed JSON remains pending annotation. Automatic prose coding never selects a sentence from a longer response. Volunteered JSON in primary prose remains pending annotation. Text observed during tool turns remains available for annotation if the session ends before a final answer; it does not become a complete handoff.
measurements.calibration: Known correct, wrong, negated, ambiguous and conflicting answers; independent numerical/time references; source mutation and real-host boundary checks. Include conditional or contradicted prose outside a word-list heuristic, mixed text/tool responses, call-limit exhaustion and later tool/request failures. Separately authored expected timelines cover conjunctions, alternative support routes, scope/version applicability and newest-dated-fact selection.
measurements.reliability: Retain automatic labels, masked human labels, quotations and reasons; contradictory or ambiguous expressions remain pending. Pilot repetitions estimate stochastic variation; no stability claim follows from a single execution.
measurements.validity: Measures the task decision expressed; citation agreement and reporting compliance are separate. Complete free-text argument quality and human effort remain outside scope.
measurements.measurement_invariance: The same independent task rubric applies across arms, response modes, models and sessions; parser coverage is measured rather than assumed invariant.
measurements.reactivity: The primary task requests ordinary prose without an experimental JSON contract. Diagnostic format variants deliberately change reporting burden.
measurements.error_model: Unclassified decisions remain unknown with explicit bounds until blind annotation. Invalid optional side effects do not invalidate a known decision; unresolved secondary dimensions remain unknown.
measurements.blinding: Automatic annotation never receives arm labels or the reference. Manual items hide case, model, arm, condition and reference metadata; quoted answer content may reveal treatment. The separate mapping joins codes only after annotation.

measurements.observable: Initial, each subsequent-session and cumulative API input/output/cached/reasoning tokens, request costs, wall time, native probes, host collections/reuses, setup time and prompt sizes.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: provider.BudgetedClient append-only ledger, session.SessionRunner, resources.ResourceSummary and reporting.ReportBuilder.
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds, token/call counts and estimated USD
measurements.timing: Initial and each recipient session, then total per condition.
measurements.preprocessing: Count every attempted request and both collection paths, including initial setup and diagnostic donor preparation. Keep token/collection/timing completeness flags and unknown amounts. Cost per task-correct decision requires complete outcomes and resource usage; pending labels retain bounds. Report each diagnostic donor once as shared preparation and recipient marginal costs separately. Reconcile each session's exact API attempt identifiers with the journal. Explicit empty receipts identify confirmed pre-request zero work; missing, duplicate or misattributed records leave accounting incomplete and suppress finite API/cost/token contrasts. Diagnostic shared-donor and unique-recipient subtotals include separately measured workflow preparation.
measurements.calibration: Known/unknown ledger costs, interrupted requests, cumulative arithmetic and cloned-state compatible/fresh collection counts. Missing whole journals, missing attempts within one arm, explicit pre-request zero, preparation interruption and unique diagnostic aggregation.
measurements.reliability: Recorded monotonic durations and provider usage; no assertion that local collector timing represents remote infrastructure.
measurements.validity: All recorded machine/API resources count; API rates are estimates. Pre-authored EAL excludes authoring effort, and host infrastructure prices/human effort are unmeasured. Local fixture latency does not represent a remote evidence system. Diagnostic workflow preparation includes donor construction, current-state preparation and clone construction; preparation timing excludes fingerprinting and diagnostic serialisation/logging. Session timing retains the session-runner interval, including request journalling and input-file persistence; report computation and annotation are outside these intervals. Additional task families collect one bundled fact snapshot; savings concern snapshot reuse, not selective acquisition of individual facts.
measurements.measurement_invariance: The same serial transport, budgeting and accounting applies; prompts may differ as an intended workflow component.
measurements.reactivity: A reservation limit or execution timeout can stop a plan before all cells; no outcome-selected extension.
measurements.error_model: Persist request starts before transmission; distinguish incomplete attempts, unobserved sessions and pending labels from measured zero or incorrect decisions.
measurements.blinding: Mechanical aggregation does not use desired answer quality to select attempts.

measurements.observable: Donor-state and fixture fingerprints, current task-fact fingerprint, declared variant, actual projection/notes/response mode and collection events.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: DiagnosticPilot clones one donor state into independent variant directories; records intervention manifests and manipulation checks.
measurements.scale_or_units: Exact fingerprint equality, categorical variants and collector counts.
measurements.timing: Before each diagnostic recipient and after preparation/execution.
measurements.preprocessing: A component contrast is interpretable only when shared-state, unchanged-fixture and relevant fact-equality checks pass and the assigned component is delivered. Keep invalid contrasts with their raw outcomes and costs.
measurements.calibration: Clone independence, source/observation/note tampering, fixed fixture, one-factor variation and expected eligible reuse versus forced collection.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic fingerprints and retained manifests can be inspected and replayed.
measurements.validity: Controls recorded donor/history and current factual content for a component contrast; does not establish unobserved semantic equivalence.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Identical checks within each declared diagnostic factor; equality requirements differ only where the factor intentionally changes a field.
measurements.reactivity: Explicit diagnostic stale-note injection is labelled and confined to diagnostics; primary notes remain natural answers.
measurements.error_model: Missing or unequal required fingerprints and absent manipulation records make attribution invalid, not a scored model loss.
measurements.blinding: Mechanical checks use assigned factor but do not inspect whether its answer is favourable.

measurements.observable: Duration and position of authoring, correction, maintenance and host activities in each arm.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Versioned adoption_costs CLI ledger, run/plan digest, event IDs and measurement references.
measurements.timing: Initial work at session zero; subsequent work at its recipient position.
measurements.preprocessing: Sum each event once through the observed horizon; add reconciled API expenditure.
measurements.calibration: Reject duplicate identities, invalid units, missing references and mismatched run/plan.
measurements.reliability: Auditable external activity log; reliability depends on actual log completeness.
measurements.validity: Unknown rates or incomplete coverage leave total cost unknown.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same categories, coverage rules and valuation units in both arms.
measurements.reactivity: Manual activity recording can add effort; record it if inside the declared costing scope.
measurements.error_model: Unrecorded activity remains unknown; declared rates are valuation assumptions.
measurements.blinding: Activity recorder sees workflow; outcome correctness is independently coded.

design.rationale: Estimate the complete ordinary/EAL workflow contrast; select a feasible independent evaluation allocation using both joint decision power and precision. Matched-fact component diagnostics use cloned donors.
design.setting: Automated live API calls on synthetic projects.
design.temporal_structure: Initial plus ten fresh recipient sessions with retained project state and empty provider conversation history. Facts may change at declared recipient positions; all earlier observations and failures remain represented. Additional-family snapshots change at positions 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10; intervening odd positions keep the same observation identity and outcome under a 60-second inclusive TTL.
design.assignment_method: The default pilot crosses six evaluation cases, two donors, two recipients, two native-tool settings, four repetitions and both arms. Shuffle matched blocks and arm order with seed 20260928. All allocation candidates retain the same six tasks and model/tool cells. External manifests and cadence plans prospectively declare separate populations.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable: no human allocation; case oracle never enters a prompt.
design.masking: Task annotation receives no condition or oracle metadata; independent scorer compares codes with a task reference. Full answer text may reveal treatment.
design.comparator: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.

units.target_population_or_system: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
units.sampling_frame: Default six-case finite pool; calibration cases excluded. Manifest cohorts are separately declared.
units.experimental_unit: Primary: one isolated initial-plus-ten-recipient arm sequence, paired with the corresponding other workflow. Diagnostic: one independently cloned recipient state within a common donor block.
units.observational_unit: Task answer, API attempt, collector event, annotation or manipulation check.
units.assignment_unit: Primary: matched block order and within-block arm order. Diagnostic: recipient variant order within each common donor block.
units.analysis_unit: Primary: a matched pair of complete session trajectories retaining case, donor, recipient, tool access and repetition. Precision is conditional on the finite declared case/configuration mixture. Diagnostics: factor-specific recipient contrasts within donor blocks.
inclusion_criteria: Every planned sequence and session retained.
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people. Separate AI authorship provides a distinct construction process, not external investigator or human-developer independence. Evaluation uses fresh executions and is not pooled with pilot observations.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Pre-authored EAL source, task contract, typed task method, TOML collector and persisted observations. A host adapter derives a scoped decision from the actual assessment; the model receives compact current task context.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Evidence reuse/acquisition, task evaluation and economical delivery of the checked task result.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: EALKnowledgeBase, ModelContextAdapter, TaskContract/task adapter and ContextStrategy implementations.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One host assessment per EAL session; ten recipients per principal arm and four independent repetitions per stratum.
manipulation_checks: Record host assessments, source-contract validation, collections/reuses and the delivered task context.
off_target_checks: Hold the external task, model configuration, budget and recipient native-tool setting fixed. Prompt length, host computation and retained-information organisation are intended whole-workflow differences.
recovery_checks: Empty conversation history each session; persist the latest complete raw answer as an ordinary project artefact in both arms, subject to the common 8192-byte limit; record oversized-note omissions. The compact EAL prompt uses the current checked task context rather than repeated specification and old notes.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Separate one-factor cloned-donor recipient variants: compact/full presentation of equal current facts; prior notes omitted/included; prose/prompted JSON/schema JSON; compatible reuse/forced collection.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Candidate presentation, conflict, reporting and evidence-acquisition pathways.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Four donor blocks, four donor sessions and 28 recipient sessions; each factor is varied only in eligible declared cases.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Recipient after one recorded donor session and fixed external fixture transition.
manipulation_checks: Hash shared state before each variant; preserve external fixture; validate equal task facts and actual intended variation.
Record a predeclared dated synthetic stale-note injection only in the notes diagnostic.
off_target_checks: Independent clones prevent one recipient output changing another recipient input.
Factor-specific contrasts are not pooled into the primary workflow comparison.
recovery_checks: Retain pristine donor snapshot and all cloned initial-state fingerprints; mark failed checks invalid.

controls.description: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Curated baseline knowledge changing the intended comparator.
controls.implementation: Project files and fresh-session messages; the latest complete naturally generated answer is retained as a project note, subject to the common 8192-byte limit; omitted oversized notes are recorded without requiring the model to write a file or obey a reporting schema.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Inspect raw session inputs and file snapshots; suspend claims if leaked current fixture/oracle data entered prompts.

controls.description: Independent task arithmetic, actual EAL source-to-task calibration and adversarial source/statement mutations before API use.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A defective authored argument, missing task meaning, wrong qualification or circular reference being attributed to model behaviour.
controls.implementation: TaskContract, ContractCalibration and production packet/context tests.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Failed correspondence blocks live calls and remains an instrument/source defect, irrespective of the recipient model.

controls.description: Separate cloned-donor diagnostics with declared one-factor recipient variants and equal current task facts where required.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Attributing effects to reuse, compression, stale notes or reporting while donor history or external evidence also changes.
controls.implementation: diagnostics.DiagnosticPilot and diagnostic-plan.json: four shared donor blocks, 28 independent recipient variants and explicit manipulation checks.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Report each factor separately. A failed manipulation invalidates its attribution but preserves attempts/resources. No claim of unique mechanism follows from a favourable primary result.

controls.description: Task-answer annotation is separate from API reporting format and correctness scoring.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Counting a parseable but differently worded answer as wrong, or allowing the task reference to choose its interpretation.
controls.implementation: Conservative automatic annotation; blind export/import for pending answers and an all-answer audit; unchanged raw records and versioned derived rows.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Keep pending decisions and disputed codes unknown; report the effect of annotation revisions and unresolved bounds.

confounds.description: Reasoning setting varies with model family. The primary EAL treatment changes information access, host computation, prompt organisation and naturally generated notes together.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Whole-workflow differences cannot identify isolated reasoning, notation or every EAL component.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Cross donors with every task; retain all inputs and notes; analyse primary whole-workflow profiles and separate cloned-donor component contrasts.
confounds.diagnostic: Exact snapshots, recipient tool masks, initial/later prompts, matched task/configuration cells, component checks and annotation coverage.
confounds.residual_risk: No population, human or pure reasoning claim. Separate AI authorship broadens task construction without establishing external investigator independence or representative task sampling.

confounds.description: Answer-format and automatic annotation coverage can vary by condition/model.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Reporting burden can change the answer, and limited parsing can change its measured score without a task error.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Primary prose answers; record format separately; pending classifications remain unknown; blind manual review; separate three-mode diagnostic.
confounds.diagnostic: Pending fraction and format compliance by condition; masked audit of automatic labels; decision contrasts before/after documented annotation.
confounds.residual_risk: Manual coding can still infer treatment from content; small diagnostic samples do not establish format invariance.

estimands.population_or_system: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
estimands.comparator: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.
estimands.time: Initial and each of ten subsequent fresh sessions; cumulative totals at the declared horizon and trajectory at earlier positions.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-weighted declared case/configuration profiles, correctness per planned session, paired differences, initial and marginal resources; cumulative input-plus-output tokens, USD and seconds including the donor; explicit unknown bounds.
estimands.interpretation: Finite-pool whole-workflow profiles. Workflow-appropriate prompt differences and host computations form the treatment. Repeated sessions and API calls do not create independent tasks.

estimands.population_or_system: Selected diagnostic task/model/donor blocks, separately for each component contrast.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: One declared component variant on a cloned donor state.
estimands.comparator: Its paired baseline variant with the same donor snapshot and fixed fixture.
estimands.time: One fresh recipient session per variant; donor preparation counted once separately.
estimands.summary_measure: Mean paired correctness difference across independent donor blocks, with simultaneous empirical Bernstein bounds across reported contrasts; invalid or unannotated blocks contribute adverse bounds. Component resources retain their own units.
estimands.interpretation: Exploratory component sensitivity under inspected manipulations. Directional patterns motivate further testing; small samples cannot establish equivalence, unique mechanism or population effects.

estimands.population_or_system: Six separately AI-authored finite task cases crossed with two pinned donors, two pinned recipients and native tools on/off; eight threshold calibration cases are excluded from the principal estimand. Independently supplied manifests and the 18-case internal cadence fixture define separate prospective populations.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Configured EAL workflow over one initial and ten recipient sessions.
estimands.comparator: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.
estimands.time: H=10 fresh recipients, including initial expenditure.
estimands.summary_measure: Delta_Q = E[Q_EAL-Q_ordinary] over ten recipients; the non-inferiority boundary is -0.05.
estimands.interpretation: Conditional expected performance for the declared finite task/configuration mixture, estimated on fresh evaluation executions. Practical support requires all three relevant uncertainty bounds to satisfy their thresholds; these are prospective operating defaults, not empirically established universal margins.

method_selection.rationale: Estimate a practical joint quality/resource contrast over a declared reuse horizon; use pilot-calibrated simulation to allocate information within the budget. Separate component perturbations investigate specific uncertainties.

alternatives_considered: A human study measures same/different-developer effort and source authoring; this automated investigation cannot substitute for it.

design_assessment.decision_use: Does EAL preserve correctness within five percentage points, exceed 90% absolute correctness and save over 20% cumulative tokens at ten fresh recipients, with an affordable allocation that controls false success and has useful joint decision power; which matched-fact diagnostics distinguish host reasoning and reuse contributions?
design_assessment.effect_or_precision_basis: Engineering thresholds are preserved prospectively: -0.05 relative correctness, 0.90 absolute correctness, 0.20 saving. Precision and joint decision power are separate targets.
design_assessment.pilot_basis: Four complete independent paired trajectories per stratum is a minimum; actual live nuisance data and sensitivity remain necessary.
